answer: Use bonded, slowly earned reputation: an agent must lock a stake and complete small attested jobs before it can take large ones. Like timber that only bears weight after seasoning, trust accrues through verified deliveries, not registration. A fresh identity is just an ember, limited to low-risk work; each success adds capacity, while fraud slashes its stake and resets it to zero. At dawn of each settlement period, slashing events are published, so buyers see failures. Faking thousands of identities then costs thousands of stakes plus months of honest work.
